Ajit K Dubey: Ajit has more than a decade of experience at financial institutions including Goldman Sachs, Bank of America and American Express. He also built an AI startup, Bond Intelligence Inc, which uses machine learning and big data to predict risk and price in the fixed income markets and to find relative value. He has been a guest lecturer and industry collaborator with the University of Washington's CFRM Class of 2019, and has served as a reviewer for IEEE Intelligent Systems on AI in Fintech. He represented Bond Intelligence Inc. on the XBRL Business Reporting Standards Committee and served on the WGFOA's Municipal Finance Disclosure Modernization Panel, contributing to the development and implementation of industry standards and guidelines. Earlier, he played a key role in implementing the first CNG network in Asia, including the Indian Parliament.

Ajit received a Roll of Honor from the Head of State (Mr. Gegon Apang) for winning the National Science Exhibition, attended by the President of India, Sri. R Venkatraman. He holds a degree in Mechanical Engineering from the Indian National Institute of Technology and completed leadership training at XLRI and MTC.
Mike Lockhart: Mike is a software architect who specializes in complex real-time systems, including blockchain systems. He has been an architect on several high-stakes business systems, including the initial online banking transaction processing system for Washington Mutual, and Paper Exchange, a start-up for online exchange transactions in the forest products industry that was later acquired by a German firm, PaperSpace.

At Microsoft, Mike was a principal architect. He designed and built a global pricing system that touched 90% of Microsoft's revenues, including a real-time pricing and quoting system and a product and price data warehouse used by Microsoft worldwide. He holds a patent for a real-time rules-based algorithm processing system, and has worked on two real-time embedded avionics software systems for the Boeing 737/757/767.
Shalabh Choudhri: Shalabh is a software engineer and engineering leader with experience building large-scale distributed systems and scaling software, products and teams at early-stage startups and at large institutions such as Google. His specialties include contextual data discovery, storage systems and ML infrastructure.

At Google, Shalabh founded the ML efforts for conversion optimization and spam and fraud detection using TensorFlow. His team was the first to build ML models based on phone call recordings, with roughly 10 models achieving over 90% accuracy in the first year.
Kumar Mehta: Kumar is the co-founder and CDO, and former CEO, of Versa Networks. He has led large projects at startups and at publicly traded companies. As VP of Engineering at Juniper Networks, he led multiple major product deliveries, including the market-leading Metro and Carrier Ethernet solution, the MX series. The solutions he designed, developed and delivered produced large and continuing revenue for the company and earned him the CEO Excellence Award. Before Juniper, Kumar held engineering management positions at Riverstone Networks and Yago Systems. He is a graduate of the Executive Program at Stanford University Graduate School of Business, and holds a master's degree in Engineering from Virginia Tech and a Bachelor of Technology from the Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur.
John Shuster: John Schuster is a technology development executive who has held leadership and engineering roles including CEO, CTO, COO and VP of Engineering. Before joining OpenEXA, he was the co-founder and COO of GeoParking Technologies, Inc., a seed-stage startup developing an Airbnb-type platform that lets robotaxi companies source between-ride and overnight parking from its local community users.

Before GeoParking, John worked in the satellite industry as a Senior Technical Program Manager on Amazon's Kuiper Project and as the SVP of Engineering at LeoSat. Earlier in his career, he co-founded NudgeRx, which developed and launched a call-center and internet-based service to reduce hospital readmission for heart surgery patients. He was also CTO of Terabeam Corporation, a unicorn start-up in 2000, where he was technical lead of the team that raised over $526M in equity financing and established the company as a leader in wireless optical communications. John received his MBA in Finance from The Wharton School of Business and his BS in Engineering and Applied Science from Caltech.
Victor Gamolsky: Victor is a business process expert who analyzes, designs and implements processes that improve organizational efficiency and productivity. He specializes in identifying process bottlenecks and improving workflow.

Victor has 10 years of experience with Lean Startup methods, including Customer Development, Business Model Generation and Blue Ocean strategy. He co-founded Roomful, a metaverse company, and served as the CTO of Database Republic, a BPM company. He graduated from a top university in Russia with a degree in Nuclear Physics and has worked with Silicon Valley startups since.
Abhishek Sinha: Abhishek has over a decade of experience implementing V1 initiatives in blockchain technology. He has worked at large technology companies including Amazon and Microsoft.

His expertise is in project planning and in managing software projects with a strong focus on customer experience. He builds cross-functional, global working relationships, and his strengths include strategic planning, analytical problem solving, and data mining for business insight.
Dipit Nanawati: Dipit has advised some of the largest Wall Street firms on business function optimization, regulatory compliance, revenue recognition and cost reduction. His expertise covers capital markets, and trade surveillance and transaction monitoring in correspondent banking, broker/dealer, hedge funds and asset management.

He has a deep understanding of the regulatory side of financial services: anti-financial crime, AML, BSA, OFAC, KYC, enterprise case management and trade surveillance. His work includes integrating data sets, performing analytical calculations, building and configuring models, and model validation and tuning. He has worked at institutions such as Chainvine, Goldman Sachs, Nomura Securities, Deutsche Bank, Citibank, Nice Actimize, JPMorgan Chase, Barclays Capital, Fluere Analytics, Bank of America Merrill Lynch and Standard Chartered.
Subuddh Parekh: Subuddh Parekh is a machine learning expert with experience in product and engineering. He holds a Bachelor of Science and a Master of Science in Computer Science from Stanford University. He was a member of the early team at PayPal and has also worked at Western Union and Rakuten. His interests include the impact of AI on people and the use of AI to make markets more accessible and efficient. Outside work, he writes screenplays and makes films.
